title: Tenma Saki — Lesson From A Future Star〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Event: That day, the Sky was Far Away

rows.Line: Saki's Room

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I'm glad Shiho told us about what she went through during junior high.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(But it was so painful to hear...
I keep beating myself up about not being there for her then too...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Like I said before...
The point of me doing this wasn't to make you all feel this way.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Again, don't beat yourselves up over this. The moral of my story is that...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That you're glad you didn't give up, right...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Back then, I just couldn't give up.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'd convinced myself that we couldn't really be friends anymore, but deep down, I was hoping that we could.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
As a result, I had to suffer for it.
I was so afraid that I'd end up creating more problems instead of solving them. However...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I endured, and I was rewarded with Ichika and Saki getting our band back together. I'm here today because I didn't give up...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So I'm really glad that I held on to my music, and more importantly, all of you...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I want our band to do well.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I want to make it so she knows that not giving up was worth it and that it's fun to be in a band with us.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Okay!
Time to fix all the mistakes I made during practice today!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'll start by going over my part for tomorrow and...
Lunch break
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wow, Shiho, your lunch looks amazing♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: No Salisbury steaks for you.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Haha. I know they're your favorite, so I won't do that to you! But those croquettes...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: No.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Why not?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki is one of those people who likes to swap entrees.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I understand how she feels. It's sort of like seeing what it's like to eat at a friend's house.

rows.Speaker: Club Captain
rows.Line:
Tenma, there you are.
I hate to bother you during lunch like this, but do you have a minute to talk...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Of course! Sorry, be right back!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Isn't she the captain of the soft tennis club...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, what do you think's going on?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Welcome back, Saki.
What did the captain want to discuss with you?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So, we're having a little get-together with students from another school soon.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But I had to duck out of practice before I could hear about it the other day, so she came to tell me about what happened.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: She invited me to come along since it's supposed to be more fun and recreational...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Do you not want to go...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: No, I really do...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It's just... I've been avoiding going to these because I'm always worried that I wouldn't have enough stamina...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But lately, I've been able to keep up with the other first-years during practice, so I'm thinking about giving this one a shot.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: At the same time...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (We've only just started being a serious band...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm glad music... No, I'm glad you found a way back to your friends, Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thanks...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You should go, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You're worried about balancing that with band practice, right? You should still go.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: B-But...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Our last show went so well.
If we practice really hard right now, our next show could be...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm glad that you're so motivated.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I know we're trying to go pro, but it's important to have time for yourself. Like they say, “All work and no play makes Jill a dull girl.”

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Plus, you're already doing plenty...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You've been putting plenty of effort into not just our band, but work, school and club activities.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That's why I want you to take advantage of these sorts of opportunities. I mean, you still have to make up for all that time you missed in junior high, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Shiho...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: She's right. We know your club means quite a lot to you.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, you should have as much fun as possible with them too.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hona, Ichi...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
*Sob*
I love you girls so much!!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wah! S-Saki!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You're next, Hona! Bear hug!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Eep! Hehe. Oh, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Last but not least! Shiho, come here!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: H-Hey, don't make me drop my lunch!

rows.Speaker: Ichika, Saki & Honami
rows.Line:
Haha.
Hehe.
